I bought a new Samsung A 8 Tablet with wi-fi only with particular attention to the GPS capabilities.  It is the best choice for OsmAnd routing and location software.  I have this device about a week and it seems to be working beautifully at this point.  

I have decided not to use a simm card or cellular services in the USA as they are comparatively costly, and I find little real need for a cellular connection. So for what it's worth, now you know.

I  lived homeless in Isla Vista for almost 2 years, December 2001, 2002,  March 2003 .... returned for visit January to March 2019 after touring Europe 2018.

Many homeless people have died. Those that lived are interesting case studies. 

Isla Vista is an unincorporated community populated primarily by University of California Santa Barbara students, as Isla Vista borders the university, UCSB.

Since March 2020, the university has been deserted.

The homeless situation in California is not as bad as it is made out to be. Most communities strongly regulate the problem, containing it as best as possible.

Very nice university campus for bicycle riding, located immediately east of Isla Vista along the Pacific Ocean. I ride here daily. Notice the lagoon. Except for occasional small aircrafts overhead, a very lovely and presently deserted place.
Yet upon this wonderful campus we find gangland graffiti. I don't think the students did this. Warning: graphic content follows
It could be some sort of independent art project. It's located on campus.

This is my new digital communications center, camera, and navigation device.  

It's built upon a Samsung Galaxy Tab A wifi-only 8inch tablet model SM-T290.  

I have attached a bluetooth keyboard, and both the tablet and keyboard are charged through a usb solar panel with standby external usb battery. 

The tablet without the keyboard has it's own protective case, and serves as as a very responsive GPS, camera and notebook while on the road, roaming from one wifi signal to another.  

This setup seems to be all that's needed to do anything expected of a personal computer, including setting up and managing a remote server.  

There is a re-learning curve, because screen movements are performed with finger rather than mouse, and of course, nothing replaces a full size desktop system and an easy chair.  

At this time, this system seems quite capable of anything, and ideally suited for long distance bicycle work/travel.

Below is a photo album of some scenes near the coastal lagoon area of UCSB, University of California Santa Barbara East of Isla Vista. 

The campus is basically deserted. Very few people around anywhere. From old signs posted, the campus seems to have been  mostly vacant since March 2020.

Quite a large and beautiful campus, definitely world class. So nice to have it mostly to myself, at least for a while.

The weather is absolutely wonderful, day and night. So fresh from the ocean breeze. 
.

The greens, the bikepath, the lagoon, the trees, the sea, the horizon ... rare is there a more majestic scene but from the mountain tops.  The sea gulls and bird life, and most especially, the absence of people.
